svg.title: What $20 a day of betting costs in a year
svg.desc: Expected loss on $7,300 of bets, winning half of them. One game at a time at standard minus 110 odds, about 4.5 cents per dollar: about $330. All bets at the 2025 average, about 10 cents per dollar: about $740. Four-pick parlays, about 17 cents per dollar: about $1,240. These are averages; in any one year some bettors come out ahead and many lose more, and the more you bet, the closer your results get to the average.
